title: The Princess of Bagdad: A Play In Three Acts
sourceTitle: The Princess of Bagdad: A Play In Three Acts
author: Alexandre Dumas
description: "The Princess of Bagdad: A Play In Three Acts" by Alexandre Dumas is a theatrical work written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The play focuses on the tumultuous life of Lionnette, the Countess de Hun, as she navigates her love and marriage to John de Hun amidst financial ruin, societal expectations, and the allure of luxury through the affections of the wealthy Nourvady.

authorInfo.bio: Alexandre Dumas (1824–1895) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include Twenty years after, Camille (La Dame aux Camilias), The Hero of the People: A Historical Romance of Love, Liberty and Loyalty. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.
